recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
echo "keyAlias=keyAlias\nkeyPassword=keyPassword\nstoreFile=/dev/null\nstorePassword=storePassword" >> keystore.properties
sed -r '/create\("release"\) \{/,/\}/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
git clone https://codeberg.org/IzzyOnDroid/gradlew.py.git
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/defaultRelease/compileDefaultReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=1fea45291461f4dbd815415eb0f158b9c5539ed6
for _ in {1..10}; do
gradlew.py/gradlew.py -v clean assembleRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
mv app/build/outputs/apk/default/release/app-default-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
